verifier_findings: The train.py-only patch implements one attributable numerical-format policy: enable the existing BF16 norm-output policy while exempting exactly the serial, pre-MLP sandwich, and parallel shared-h MLP-input norms.

Exempted calls execute the original non-cast norm path, without BF16-then-FP32 conversion. The sandwich post-MLP norm and other norm call sites remain unchanged; the parallel shared-h exemption also affects attention as explicitly approved.

The default-on toggle, environment override, positive/negative CLI flags, effective-policy assignment, startup logging, and checkpoint toggle registration match the proposal. Disabling the new toggle with otherwise baseline defaults restores the original behavior.

Candidate checkpoints persist both precision toggles, and load_for_eval restores them before model construction. The patch introduces no future-token dependency, evaluation-time adaptation, external data, or pretrained initialization.

The patch leaves optimizer, schedule, parameter shapes, kernels, data loading, tokenizer, evaluator, seed-42 default, distributed/full-chip launch behavior, and 1800-second budget accounting unchanged. Supplied deterministic checks pass; runtime gates remain for the controller.
